authority.status: NOT A SOURCE OF TRUTH — derived, superseded, retained as history
authority.why: Significant link repair has been performed IN PLACE on individual sites since this scan and was never backpropagated here. The sites are authoritative; this file records what a scan saw on 2026-07-08 and nothing since. A verdict in this file may have been acted on, reversed, or rendered moot by a page that no longer exists in that form.

coverage_when_measured.note: 31% of the current corpus. Of what it did scan, 45,954 were no_id, 11,710 ambiguous and 139 unknown — so confident verdicts covered roughly 3% of the scan. It is a sample, not an inventory, and it is a month stale against a corpus that has tripled.

authority.do_not: Do not use this file to plan a batch operation, to decide whether a link is correct, or as evidence that a link was fixed. Read the site.
authority.if_an_inventory_is_needed: Rebuild it from the sites, and treat the rebuild as derived on the day it runs rather than as a standing authority. Any inventory of a living corpus is a photograph.
